A record is invalid when the information cutoff (`known_as_of`) comes after the prediction timestamp (`predicted_at`). The contract requires `known_as_of <= predicted_at`, so equal timestamps are allowed. A later cutoff would mean the prediction used information learned after it was made.

ANSWER_PATH: 07_EVALUATION/polymarket/PREDICTION_LEDGER_CONTRACT.md
ANSWER: `known_as_of > predicted_at` is invalid because it would use information learned after the prediction (`known_as_of` is the information cutoff and MUST be `<= predicted_at`).
